reasoning: Both attempts keep the list on the server and fix the HUD flags the same way. B turned AdminServerService into a folder with init.luau but changed its sibling requires to \"../AdminNetwork\" and \"../AdminSharedService\". Those resolve against script.Parent.Parent, which is AdminSystem, so the server module fails to load. Announcements then stop working and the client's InvokeServer never returns. A keeps the original require paths, puts RelocateToServerScriptService on AdminList's own meta, and works. Its only weakness is that it waits on InvokeServer inside Start.

criteria.note: New AdminList.meta.json sets RelocateToServerScriptService: true (a boolean) on the module itself.

criteria.criterion: No client-copied module requires the list
criteria.note: AdminSharedService drops require("./AdminList") and IsAdmin; only AdminServerService, which stays in ServerScriptService, requires ./AdminList, a module that also stays there.

Start calls AdminNetwork.CheckAccess:InvokeServer() inside a pcall, which waits until the server's handler is set, so a late answer still shows the panel; but the wait happens inside Start rather than in a spawned task.
onAnnounce still calls AdminServerService:IsAdmin(player.UserId), now backed by AdminList on the server, and keeps the type, empty, utf8 and length checks.
Adds _HudClientSetup.meta.json with ClientOnly: true and changes HudClientService's "true" to true.
Changes stay in AdminSystem and HudSystem; selene and StyLua pass; the luau-lsp failure is a tool path error that affects both attempts the same way.
_AdminList is nested under the AdminServerService ModuleScript, whose init.meta.json sets RelocateToServerScriptService: true, so the list stays on the server with its parent.

criteria.criterion: No client-copied module requires the list
criteria.note: AdminSharedService no longer requires AdminList, but AdminServerService/init.luau now uses require("../AdminNetwork") and require("../AdminSharedService"), which point one level too high (script.Parent.Parent) and fail.
task.spawn(showPanelIfAdminAsync) is a good pattern, but because the server module fails on its requires, IsAdmin.OnServerInvoke is never set and InvokeServer never returns.
onAnnounce keeps the IsAdmin and validation logic, but the module errors at require time, so the handler is never connected.
Same as A: ClientOnly: true on _HudClientSetup, and HudClientService's flag changed to a boolean.
Stays in scope and selene and StyLua pass, but restructuring AdminServerService into a folder introduced the broken require paths.

strengths: Small, correct fix: the list's own meta gets RelocateToServerScriptService
The shared module no longer requires the list, and the server keeps the admin check
Remote answers only about the caller
HUD fixed with real boolean flags
weaknesses: InvokeServer is called inside Start, so it waits there instead of using task.spawn
The pcall hides errors without logging them

strengths: Nesting the list under a server-only module is a valid way to keep it off clients
Spawns the client's InvokeServer call so Start doesn't wait on it
HUD fixed with real boolean flags
weaknesses: require("../AdminNetwork") and require("../AdminSharedService") in init.luau point at AdminSystem instead of SystemPackage, so AdminServerService fails to load
As a result, announcements are never handled and admins never see the panel
Moving the module into a folder adds churn that wasn't needed
